decisions.reason: This looks like an incremental rebranding and refinement of an already accepted trommel screen, so it is very close to the firm's existing knowledge base and easy for management to support and improve.

Mobile high-speed flail shredders fit the firm's established mobile waste-processing machinery capabilities, and a dedicated page plus several models suggest sufficient commitment to continue learning rather than exit quickly.
A mobile high-speed grinder is still closely related to the firm's core shredding and processing business, so despite limited market evidence the firm is likely to retain it and build experience.

The stationary electric fine shredder is technically adjacent to the firm's established stationary processing equipment, but the weaker website presence makes it somewhat more vulnerable than the more prominently presented launches.

The green-waste mobile grinder remains within the firm's related knowledge, yet as a more specific niche offer with only limited visible promotion it has a slightly higher chance of being withdrawn if uptake disappoints.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are strongly aligned with the firm's long experience in stationary material-processing systems, and a dedicated page with several models points to a product line the firm is likely to develop further.
